verdict.rationale: IRCC is a government immigration agency and its public services portal (work permits, visas, processing times, status checks), not a software tool that someone installs or runs. Running it headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows IRCC ships a CLI, API or automation mode that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
